item.title: Podcast: Introducing AI to elementary students
item.description: Researchers talk about the difficulties of teaching AI concepts to young children and how their efforts resulted in a successful project.

item.title: New catalyst turns plant waste into useful chemicals
item.description: Scientists developed an efficient catalyst that breaks down lignin from plant waste into valuable chemicals under mild conditions.

item.title: Shingles vaccine linked to 24% lower dementia risk
item.description: A study of over 500 older adults found that those who received the Shingrix shingles vaccine had a 24% lower risk of dementia diagnosis over four years.
